title: Park Tool PCS-9.3 Thumbscrew replacement
author: raketqueen1911
description:
I created this replacement thumbscrew for the Park Tool PCS 9.3. The thumbscrew to secure the folding legs of the PCS-9.3 is lousy, The threading loose in normal usage. All you need is an M6 35mm hex head bolt and flange nut.

The filler included is not a requirement, I just created to fill the hole and make it look nice.

Printed in Bambu Lab PETG-HF filament with the settings below.

Nozzle = 0.4mm

Layer height = 0.16mm high quality

Quality:

Seam position = back

Ironing type = Top surfaces

Strength:

Wall loops = 4

Top surface pattern = Rectilinear

Bottom surface pattern = Rectilinear

Sparse infill density = 50%

Sparse infill pattern = Gyroid

Support = enabled

Infill gap = 100%

park tool pcs-9 bike stand bike repair stand

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
